fields.message:
Leave a field empty to use the default wording. Merge tags are replaced when the email is sent; each email lists the ones it supports.

Write messages as plain text. They're sent in the website's design (logo, colours and fonts), with a plain-text copy for email apps that don't show it. A link on its own line becomes a button. Lines starting with "- " become a bulleted list.

fields.label: Footer
fields.name: email_footer
fields.instructions: Shown at the bottom of every email, one item per line (an email address on its own line becomes a link). Leave empty to use the website footer's tagline and contact email.
fields.placeholder:
Making separation feel less alien
info@theexfiles.co.uk

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: verify_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {link}. Sent to accounts from before the checkout, and when someone asks for a new link.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: verify_paid_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {link}. Sent to new clients once their payment is confirmed: clicking the link opens their Ex File.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: active_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {link}. {link} confirms their email first if they haven't yet, otherwise goes through the log in page to the service they chose.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: unpaid_reminder_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}. Sent when a sign-up at checkout needs checking by hand. There's no link: they're emailed one when you clear the check or ask for more information. Never mention conflicts.

fields.label: Body
fields.name: unpaid_reminder_body
fields.instructions: Sent once, a day after someone gives their details at checkout but doesn’t pay (unless they ticked not to be reminded). Tags: {first_name}, {service}, {link} (back to their basket), {delete_date}.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: review_checkout_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}. Sent when a sign-up at checkout needs checking by hand. There's no link: they're emailed one when you clear the check or ask for more information. Never mention conflicts.

fields.label: More information needed (in My Ex File)
Subject
fields.name: info_requested_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {question}, {link}. {link} confirms their email first if they haven't yet, otherwise goes through the log in page to the reply form.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: info_requested_email_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {question}. For sign-ups waiting at checkout: they reply to the email, so there's no link. Never mention conflicts.

fields.label: Message
fields.name: order_confirmed_body
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {order_items} (service plus any add-on), {amount}, {appointment}, {meeting_details} (how the appointment works and the meeting link), {next_steps}, {cancellation}, {link}

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: appointment_moved_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {appointment}, {old_appointment}, {meeting_details}, {link}. Sent with an updated calendar invite.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: appointment_cancelled_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {appointment}, {reason}. {reason} is the sentence for the reason you choose when cancelling (empty for "Other"). Sent with a calendar cancellation.

fields.label: To you: appointment moved or cancelled
Subject
fields.name: admin_appointment_changed_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {client_name}, {service}, {what} (moved or cancelled), {appointment}, {calendar_note} (says whether Outlook was updated or a calendar file is attached), {admin_link}.

fields.label: To you: questionnaire not received in time
Message
fields.name: document_ready_body
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {document}, {attachment_note} (says whether the file is attached), {link}

fields.label: Message
fields.name: consultation_open_body
fields.instructions: Sent when you share a report with a client who paid for a consultation add-on. Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {addon}, {link}

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: consultation_offer_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {addon}, {price}, {link}. Sent when a report is ready for a client who didn’t add the consultation when they ordered.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: questionnaire_reminder_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {link}, {appointment}, {before_appt} (for the reminder before an appointment: the appointment and when the answers are needed by)

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: questionnaire_received_subject
fields.instructions: Merge tags: {first_name}, {service}, {link}, {report_due} (when the written report will be sent, if the service has a report deadline)
